task_summary: Calculate Pearson correlation between HP-filtered cyclical components of real PCE and real PFI (1973-2024) using ERP tables and CPI data.
decomposition_rationale: The task is a single end-to-end pipeline with tightly coupled steps (parse, deflate, filter, correlate). Splitting into more than 2 skills would create artificial boundaries. Two skills cleanly separate data ingestion/cleaning from the econometric analysis pipeline.

skills.name: evo-macro-data-ingestion
skills.description: Parses ERP .xls tables and FRED CPI .xlsx files, handles multi-row headers, extracts annual totals, computes partial-year averages from quarterly data, and produces clean annual CPI series.
skills.responsibility: All data reading, parsing, cleaning, and temporal aggregation from raw Excel files into clean pandas Series indexed by integer year.
dr_sections: 1. Parsing and Processing the Economic Report of the President (ERP) Data
2. Processing and Deflating with FRED Consumer Price Index Data
2.2 Converting Monthly CPI to Annual Frequency

skills.name: evo-macro-cycle-correlation
skills.description: Deflates nominal series to real values using CPI, applies log transformation and Hodrick-Prescott filter to extract cyclical components, and computes Pearson correlation between two cyclical series.
skills.responsibility: Deflation, log-transformation, HP filtering with lambda=100, temporal alignment (1973-2024), Pearson correlation computation, and formatted output.
dr_sections: 3. Cycle-Trend Decomposition Using the Hodrick-Prescott Filter
3.3 Handling NaNs with the HP Filter
4. Statistical Alignment and Pearson Correlation Computation
5.4 Exclusive vs. Inclusive Indexing Off-By-One Errors
